parts.text: system prompt for the wire test

functionDeclarations.name: query_short_positions
functionDeclarations.description: Get short position time series data for a specific stock over a time period. Returns short interest percentages over time, at most 40 points, always including the first and the latest.

functionDeclarations.name: get_top_shorts
functionDeclarations.description: Get the top N most shorted stocks on the ASX, ranked by current short interest percentage. Returns each stock's code, name and latest short position, with a sparkline of its short interest over the last 3 months (up to 8 points, the first and the latest always included) for the highest-ranked stocks. When the answer is long, lower-ranked stocks come without a sparkline. Stocks are left out only if even the bare rows do not fit, and omittedStocks says how many. For the full daily history of one stock, use query_short_positions.

limit.description: Number of stocks to return (default 10, max 50)

functionDeclarations.name: get_stock_details
functionDeclarations.description: Get a stock's profile: company name, industry, market cap, valuation ratios (P/E, EPS, dividend yield, 52-week range), company summary, risk factors and key people. For short-position history use query_short_positions.

functionDeclarations.name: search_stocks
functionDeclarations.description: Search for stocks by company name or stock code. Useful when the user mentions a company name and you need to find the stock code.

query.description: Search query (company name or partial stock code)

functionDeclarations.name: get_news
functionDeclarations.description: Get recent news articles for a specific stock or the broader market.

stock_code.description: ASX stock code (omit for market-wide news)

functionDeclarations.name: get_director_trades
functionDeclarations.description: Get recent director (insider) trades for a specific stock. Shows buys, sells, and option exercises by company directors.

functionDeclarations.name: get_peer_comparison
functionDeclarations.description: Compare a stock with its industry peers. Returns short interest, market cap, P/E ratio, and dividend yield for peer companies.

functionDeclarations.name: get_weekly_report
functionDeclarations.description: Get the latest weekly short selling analysis report with market trends, biggest movers, and sector analysis.

week.description: Week slug in YYYY-WNN format (e.g., '2026-W08'). Omit for the latest report.

functionDeclarations.name: get_related_news
functionDeclarations.description: Find news articles semantically related to a stock (cross-outlet, by meaning). Uses vector similarity to surface thematically relevant coverage beyond simple keyword matching.

article_id.description: Optional id of an article from an earlier get_news or get_related_news result, to find news related to that article instead of the stock's latest one. Omit it to relate to the stock's latest article.

limit.description: Number of related articles to return (default 5)

functionDeclarations.name: get_stock_graph
functionDeclarations.description: Get a stock's key people (directors/executives and their OTHER ASX board seats) and narrative-similar companies. Useful for mapping corporate networks and finding structurally similar peers.

functionDeclarations.name: get_event_timeline
functionDeclarations.description: Get a merged chronological timeline of a stock's events: announcements, director trades, price-sensitive news, and short-position spikes. Good for understanding what drove recent moves.

days_back.description: How many calendar days back to include (default 90)

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 20)

functionDeclarations.name: get_stock_signals
functionDeclarations.description: Get a stock's risk and reputation signals — adverse items (court cases, sanctions, regulatory actions, complaints, safety incidents) and positive items (awards, favourable press), each with a severity rating, its date and, where known, the publisher's domain. Use when the user asks about a company's risks, controversies, legal issues, or reputation.

limit.description: Max signals per polarity to fetch (default 10, max 50). At most 10 of each polarity reach the answer; omittedAdverse and omittedPositive count the rest.

functionDeclarations.name: get_economic_series
functionDeclarations.description: Get Australian macroeconomic and market series. Key families: rates.cash_rate_target.aus; cpi.annual_change.all_groups.aus; cpi.index.all_groups.aus; labour.unemployment_rate.total.{state}.seasadj; labour.job_vacancies.{state}; wages.wpi_yoy.{state}; wages.real_wpi_yoy.{state}; commodities.price_index.bulk.aus; credit.growth_yoy.housing.aus.seasadj; markets.short_interest_wavg.{state}; markets.short_interest_avg.{industry}.aus; trade.balance.total.{state}; spending.household.total.{state}.seasadj; lending.new_commitments.investor.{state}.seasadj; business.gross_operating_profit.{industry}.aus.seasadj; construction.work_done.total.{state}.seasadj; crime.victims.{offence}.{state}; crime.victims_rate_100k.{offence}.{state}. State values: lowercase nsw/vic/qld/sa/wa/tas/nt/act. Business industry values (ANZSIC divisions): mining, manufacturing, retail-trade. Market industry values (GICS): materials, energy, banks. Offence values: homicide, assault, sexual-assault, robbery, unlawful-entry, motor-vehicle-theft, other-theft.

functionDeclarations.name: answer_without_data
functionDeclarations.description: Call this ONLY when the reply needs no data: a greeting, a definition, an explanation of a concept, or how to use Shorted. NEVER call it when the reply will contain any figure about a stock, the market, an economic series or a person. For those, call the data tool that returns the figure.
